crossRefs.note: Woe to the bloody city! It is all full of lies and robbery. The prey doesn’t depart.
The roaring of the lion, and the voice of the fierce lion, the teeth of the young lions, are broken.
The old lion perishes for lack of prey. The cubs of the lioness are scattered abroad.
Their roaring will be like a lioness. They will roar like young lions. Yes, they shall roar, and seize their prey and…
The young lions have roared at him and yelled. They have made his land waste. His cities are burned up, without…
A lion has gone up from his thicket, and a destroyer of nations. He is on his way. He has gone out from his place, to…
“Israel is a hunted sheep. The lions have driven him away. First, the king of Assyria devoured him, and now at last…
Behold, the enemy will come up like a lion from the pride of the Jordan against the strong habitation; for I will…
and say, ‘What was your mother? A lioness. She couched among lions, in the middle of the young lions she nourished her…
Her princes within her are roaring lions. Her judges are evening wolves. They leave nothing until the next day.
Judah is a lion’s cub. From the prey, my son, you have gone up. He stooped down, he crouched as a lion, as a lioness.…
For Yahweh says to me, “As the lion and the young lion growling over his prey, if a multitude of shepherds is called…

translations.web: Where is the den of the lions, and the feeding place of the young lions, where the lion and the lioness walked, the lion’s cubs, and no one made them afraid?
translations.bsb: Where is the lions’ lair or the feeding ground of the young lions, where the lion and lioness prowled with their cubs, with nothing to frighten them away?
translations.kjv: Where is the dwelling of the lions, and the feedingplace of the young lions, where the lion, even the old lion, walked, and the lion's whelp, and none made them afraid?
translations.asv: Where is the den of the lions, and the feeding-place of the young lions, where the lion and the lioness walked, the lion's whelp, and none made them afraid?
